palais-riyad-el-fassia.shortDescription: Restored 19th-century palace with two patios, private hammam and dedicated butler service.
palais-riyad-el-fassia.description: Palais Riyad El Fassia occupies a 19th-century residence fully restored by Moroccan master craftsmen. Its two open-air patios, vaulted salons in zellige and painted wood, and indoor pool make it an exceptional address for large families or groups of friends seeking a royal stay in the heart of the medina. A dedicated team (butler, private chef, spa) is available on site throughout the stay.

riad-al-manar.shortDescription: Fully renovated traditional riad with central patio, zellige fountain and heated pool.
riad-al-manar.description: Nestled in the heart of the Marrakech medina, Riad Al Manar combines Moroccan authenticity with modern comfort. Around its open-air patio, the zellige fountain and orange trees create a serene atmosphere. The four air-conditioned suites each offer their own decorative identity, blending artisan furniture and premium bed linen. The panoramic terrace with views over the medina rooftops and the Atlas mountains is ideal for private breakfasts and dinners.

riad-jasmin.shortDescription: Intimate riad steps from Bahia Palace, artisan decor and private rooftop.
riad-jasmin.description: Riad Jasmin charms with its cozy atmosphere and decor entirely crafted by local artisans: tadelakt, carved cedar wood and handmade zellige. Located in the quiet Kasbah district, a few minutes' walk from Bahia Palace and Jemaa el-Fna square, it offers privileged access to the medina's main sights while preserving real tranquility.

villa-atlas-view.shortDescription: Contemporary villa with breathtaking Atlas views, large infinity pool and private garden.
villa-atlas-view.description: Ideal for family or friends' stays, Villa Atlas View spreads across 800 sqm of landscaped gardens around an infinity pool facing the Atlas mountains. Generous volumes, a fully equipped kitchen and a covered summer lounge make it a perfect place to entertain. A private chef and household staff can be made available on request.

villa-palmeraie-dune.shortDescription: Design villa in the heart of the Palmeraie, zen atmosphere, heated pool and wellness area.
villa-palmeraie-dune.description: Surrounded by century-old palm trees, Villa Palmeraie Dune offers a clean architecture blending polished concrete, raw wood and large glass windows. The wellness area with sauna and massage room, plus the year-round heated pool, make it a sought-after address for restorative stays.

appartement-gueliz-loft.shortDescription: Modern loft in the heart of Guéliz, close to restaurants and boutiques, terrace with city view.
appartement-gueliz-loft.description: Located in the lively Guéliz district, this loft apartment combines contemporary design and functionality. Right next to Marrakech's best restaurants and boutiques, it's an ideal base for exploring both the new town and the medina, just minutes away.

appartement-medina-suite.shortDescription: Refined suite steps from the Koutoubia, ideal for a romantic or solo stay.
appartement-medina-suite.description: This bright suite combines the charm of the medina with resolutely contemporary comfort. Its location, a few minutes' walk from the Koutoubia mosque and Jemaa el-Fna square, makes it a top pick for exploring Marrakech on foot, while enjoying a cozy, quiet interior.

t1.text: An absolutely perfect stay at Riad Al Manar. The team organized our transfer and every detail of our stay. Everything was seamless from start to finish.

t2.text: Villa Atlas View exceeds all the photos. Magnificent pool, attentive staff: one of the best memories of our trip to Morocco.

t3.text: Easy booking, quick communication in English. The riad was incredibly refined, I recommend it without hesitation.

t4.text: Excellent value for money for the apartment in Guéliz, very well located, ideal for exploring Marrakech with family.

t5.text: A level of service worthy of the finest palaces. The butler and private chef made our family reunion unforgettable, every detail was thought through.

t6.text: The villa was a haven of peace: sauna, massage, heated pool all week. Exactly the break we needed.

t7.text: Bright suite, perfectly located steps from the Koutoubia. Flawless communication before and during the stay, we highly recommend it.

t8.text: There were 14 of us for a family birthday: Palais Riyad El Fassia handled the accommodation, meals and even on-site activities. Remarkable professionalism from start to finish.

t9.text: As a regular business traveler to Marrakech, I appreciate the team's responsiveness and the consistent service at every stay in the Guéliz apartment.

t10.text: A very successful girls' trip at Villa Atlas View. The Atlas view at breakfast will remain a lasting memory. A small hiccup with the wifi, quickly resolved by the on-site team.

f1.question: How do I book a riad, palace, villa or apartment?
f1.answer: You can book directly via the site's contact form, WhatsApp or phone. We confirm availability within 24h and send you a detailed quote before any deposit request.

f2.question: Is airport transfer included?
f2.answer: Airport transfer is included for most of our riads, palaces and villas. It can be added as an option for our apartments on request.

f3.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
f3.answer: Check-in is generally from 3pm and check-out before noon. Early arrivals or late departures can be arranged depending on the property's availability.

f4.question: Are breakfast and housekeeping included?
f4.answer: It depends on the accommodation: most of our riads and palaces include breakfast and daily housekeeping. Check each property's listing for the exact details of included services.

f5.question: Can I cancel or change my booking?
f5.answer: Changes are possible up to 48h before the scheduled date, subject to availability. Check our general terms or contact our team for any specific request.
